entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine features a custom vector graph system that sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It integrates automated fact extraction and byte-level deduplication with connectors for platforms including Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An AGPL-3.0 context database that utilizes a virtual filesystem structure with viking:// URIs and tiered hierarchical loading. It provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging and has demonstrated a 91% token reduction on LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain extracts entity relationships without LLM calls and provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis. It is designed for institutional memory, supporting multi-user environments with scoped data access.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents alongside dedicated Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents through a FastAPI server that supports hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes memory implementations and offers both Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider manages context as a git-like repository with versioning features such as commit, branch, and merge. It achieves sub-100ms performance using a 5-tier retrieval system and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system manages persistent memory via Qdrant and structured facts to create an auto-curated wiki for the agent. It relies on local infrastructure including Docker, Redis, and SQLite to maintain a Ground Truth hierarchy for context prioritization.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness helps agents complete complex tasks by generating filesystem-based traces, reports, and playbooks. It supports multiple providers, including local models and OpenAI-compatible APIs, via Python and TypeScript CLI surfaces.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no messages are lost during agent operations. It features a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata and builds depth-aware summary nodes for hierarchical searching.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library to enable private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It imports data from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable memory on local disks. It supports MCP tools including Claude Code and Cursor through a local-first retrieval stack using BM25 and hybrid search.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP, Claude Code hooks, and plugins using a hybrid retrieval method involving BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to reduce prefill latency and token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, long-term memory architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching why_retrieved tags to every recall. It supports in-process embedded mode by default and includes features for contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens before the context window opens. It supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE and pairs with Perseus Vault for encrypted, persistent memory.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to store memories. It features BM25-first retrieval and an importance ranking system from 1-10 to prioritize high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates payments for APIs and AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to enable self-charging capabilities.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local capabilities such as scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It provides tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal, with an optional feature for automatic tool-routing note generation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, alongside configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports multiple execution modes via Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon. It offers HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall alongside MinHash dedup.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin provides private code memory for repositories, enabling semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It combines BM25, vector, and graph methods with automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a software development methodology using subagent-driven development for autonomous task execution. It integrates with coding harnesses like Claude, Codex, and Cursor while enforcing TDD and YAGNI principles.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports various local CLI executables and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It includes a design system for brand visual language and can generate HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It is capable of building knowledge graphs from any data format and supports Rust and TypeScript clients.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities for generating diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns through a two-pass detection process. It utilizes a 112-entry word replacement table and is compatible with Hermes and Cursor.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It integrates fragmented ecosystem layers through natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement to unify skills across multiple agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides spec-conformant Agent Plugins compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io. It includes 12 metaskills that preserve state within a docs/ folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection includes 1,099 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It also provides ready-to-paste exports for use with other assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides access to YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists via TranscriptAPI. It is compatible with the Agent Skills format and works with Hermes Agent and Cursor.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This repository offers type-safe support for agentskills.io using progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency. It supports modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts, as well as remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model. It utilizes file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides skills in SKILL.md format along with installation and configuration guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This repository provides prompting guides for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models along with API integration documentation. It offers a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills from code or documentation. It provides provenance via file and line number citations and supports Node.js and Python environments.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a Python SkillDockClient and a CLI for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It also includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Intent as Code workflow language uses a single Rust binary to manage AI tasks through four verbs. It enables local-first execution with any LLM and provides static auditing via nika check alongside tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill allows the agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This project implements a progressive MCP client using a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill employs a 5-layer retrieval system—including hard triggers and dense embeddings—to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if dependencies or embedding models are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting by using three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It verifies findings via sandbox execution to provide VERIFIED or REFUTED status and uses a deterministic pre-scan.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation by implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses local SQLite storage to manage habits and study blocks without cloud sync. It connects to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and allows users to complete tasks via tapping.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures to include multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses three parallel sub-agents—Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness—to perform multi-agent code simplification. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust through a tiered application process with an approval gate.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides 2,077 total skills and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands and integrates with MCP-compatible clients such as Hermes.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This tool automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC via protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides functional quality seals for AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street levels. It produces structured reports with core conclusions and uses semantic memory to integrate user interests.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite offers video-to-text transcription, local OCR for PDFs and images, and batch e-commerce material generation. It includes specialized features like AI text de-humanization and brand overlays.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill manages deterministic path routing between Windows, MSYS, and WSL syntaxes. It uses a PowerShell resolver to select compatible Python interpreters without making network requests or file edits.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes. These packages are updated on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Provides a Termux-based installer for Hermes Agent that uses a one-line command. This deployment supports over 200 AI models and includes a gateway service for incoming connections.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: A one-command installer that enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH). It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. This setup allows for kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A simple Docker sandbox image containing the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and hybrid skill management for both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.solomon2773/nora: A self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane designed to run and operate multiple Hermes Agent instances through a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities while offering hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A headless systemd deployment for Ubuntu and Debian servers that integrates with Nous Portal. It configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service to enable autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: A portable production package that runs from a USB or drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks within a financial trading context. It supports multiple LLM providers and employs a researcher team to assess insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It supports frameworks such as CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for registry management, security auditing, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale agents into automated teams. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms using multiple model providers and MCP tool integration. It features durable agent memory and visual org charts for delegating agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system provides a Kanban board and review queues to supervise and review autonomous Hermes Agent work. It features live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents to manage automated task lifecycles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TerminalBench-2 and TBLite while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for tool-calling and task routing without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It runs 100% locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-sync feature.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a CLI interface and a 3D visualization dashboard, with support for data submission to public profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent and other tools. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and historical usage trends across 30+ AI coding tools.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configuration.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within Claude Code without requiring OAuth or separate processes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and Solana-based payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports various AI providers and includes a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and undo functionality for agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, including memory tools for Slack, Telegram, and VS Code. It also offers a plugin for Claude Code featuring automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through specialized CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter evaluates AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies inconsistent schemas, overlapping tool descriptions, and missing stop conditions via local execution, GitHub Actions, or pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides offline, local interaction with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace available as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents and includes native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.

entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs while supporting custom LLM model routing.

entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. The interface features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent that provides real-time log streaming and chat. It integrates a file browser and a dashboard for tracking tasks, skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It offers real-time session activity and cost tracking, alongside read-only inspection of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
